source.ue: Desert Fortress UE 5.8 project, origin/main bb11cac: DT_Weapons, DT_Optics, DT_Muzzles, DT_Magazines, DA_CombatTuning, DA_MovementTuning, UTRArmory::ComputeMods/ComputeStats
source.dps: formulas of F:/TR_UE/assets/dps/DPS.md (burst = dmg x pellets / (60/RPM); sustained = mag x dmg x pellets / ((mag - 1) x 60/RPM + reload))
source.weapon_xp: NOT on origin/main yet: xp_unlock_level is null everywhere. xp_unlock_level_planned = the weaponxp branch (44667c6, build_weapon_xp.py UNLOCKS, Any / Sniper groups; a gun that cannot take an item gets the next one it takes). Levels may still change.

bar_formula.general: bar = clamp(round(10 + 90 t), 0, 100); t = (v - min) / (max - min) over the 41 guns without attachments; lower-is-better stats use 1 - t. min/max are in bar_scale, so a site can recompute bars live for a weaponsmith build (values past the scale clamp).
bar_formula.damage: t(damage_per_trigger) = damage x pellets (twin guns: 2 traces = 2 pellets)
bar_formula.control: 1 - t(recoil_deg), recoil_deg = sqrt(pitch^2 + yaw^2) kick per shot
bar_formula.mobility: t(mobility_pct), mobility_pct = MoveSpeedMul x magMoveMul x (0.5 + 0.5 x muzzleSprintMul) x 100
